title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyperparameter lambda (λ). Increasing λ can help prevent overfitting by penalizing large coefficients in the model.

title: Effect of Increasing λ
text: When you increase the value of λ in ridge regression, the penalty on the size of the coefficients increases. This means that the model will try to keep the coefficients smaller to minimize the penalty term.

title: Impact on Coefficients
text: What happens to the coefficients of the model when λ is increased?

title: Balancing Bias and Variance
text: Increasing λ can increase the bias of the model but decrease its variance. This trade-off is crucial in understanding how ridge regression works.

title: Bias-Variance Trade-off
text: How does increasing λ affect the bias and variance of the model?
